claim: Every in-repo MCP host pins only McpProtocol.v2025_06_18; none pin v2026_07_28.

A v2026_07_28-only server rejects initialize on the prepare path with ProtocolError -32022 and message initialize is not supported by the configured MCP protocols (requested '<offeredVersion>'). Stdio initialize uses the same selectStatefulProtocol path.

On a stateless-only HTTP server, an initialize JSON-RPC request with an id is classified as a stateless request; missing MCP-Protocol-Version returns HTTP 400 HEADER_MISMATCH_ERROR_CODE -32020 'MCP-Protocol-Version header is required' before the initialize-not-supported ProtocolError.

Effect permits mixed protocol lists with at most one stateless adapter. A G4 v2026_07_28-only pin is a beep policy choice, not an Effect requirement; mixed list is the option that keeps today's initialize clients working.

Public McpSchema.ClientRpcs is the stateful group (includes Initialize, not server/discover). The 2026 adapter client group is @internal and starts with Discover. In-repo RpcClient.make(McpSchema.ClientRpcs) cannot type-call server/discover.

Effect generic RpcClient HTTP does not set mcp-method, mcp-protocol-version, or mcp-name; those names appear only in mcpRuntime.ts (server-side). In-repo HTTP clients must inject 2026 routing headers themselves.

nlp-mcp is stdio layerStdio, name beep-nlp version 0.0.0, mounts NlpToolkit (25) plus StreamingToolkit (17) for 42 tools, all failureMode return, no non-object success schemas found, no MCP-layer auth, launched by .mcp.json via src/bin.ts.

m365-mcp is stdio, name beep-m365 version 0.1.0, 11-tool M365Toolkit, all failureMode return, and is the only driver host with a stdio NDJSON wire test that sends initialize protocolVersion 2025-06-18.

uspto_search_applications success schema is S.Array(UsptoApplicationMetadata), the only confirmed non-object tool success schema among in-repo hosts. uspto_get_documents uses a tagged-union object. Soft SourceAuth USPTO_API_KEY.
gov-legal-mcp is stdio beep-gov-legal version 0.0.0, four tools (eCFR none-gated always mounted, GovInfo hard-gated on GOVINFO_API_KEY), all failureMode return, object success schemas, no wire test.

practice-kg host is stdio beep-practice-kg 0.0.0 via apps/practice-kg-mcp bin, nine read-only tools, SourceAuth none, compiled smoke sends initialize 2025-06-18 then tools/list and tools/call corpus_search_text.

Ontology sidecar is the only in-repo HTTP MCP host: layerHttp path /mcp, name beep-ontology 0.0.0, v2025_06_18, Origin allowlist plus RPC session token plus CORS. CORS allowedHeaders include mcp-protocol-version and mcp-session-id but not mcp-method or mcp-name.

Ontology mutation/publish registration is config-gated (ONTOLOGY_MCP_MUTATIONS_ENABLED and destination allowlist) and dispatch is per-session GovernedTierGate with 12-hour TTL. OntologyMcpConfig has no protocol-version field.
No in-repo host registers prompts, resources, elicitation, or sampling. Reverse-client getClient is stubbed to die in tests; v2026 reverse-client methods fail unsupported.

The ontology HTTP harness first message is RpcClient.make(McpSchema.ClientRpcs) then initialize protocolVersion 2025-06-18. It sets accept, authorization, origin; replays mcp-session-id and mcp-protocol-version after initialize; never sends Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name, or _meta protocol claims.

ontology-mcp-http.test.ts rawInitialize posts a literal initialize JSON-RPC body with protocolVersion 2025-06-18 and no 2026 routing headers. execution-authority.pglite.test.ts uses the same makeMcpClient harness.
goals/ontology-agent-surface/ops/live-mcp-client.ts is an in-repo HTTP RpcClient that initialize-s 2025-06-18, captures Mcp-Session-Id, and sets only authorization and origin.

A G4 v2026_07_28-only pin breaks every in-repo wire client found (m365 stdio test, practice-kg smoke, ontology harness/HTTP tests/execution-authority/live client). G4 plus G6 are jointly unimplementable without rewriting those clients or relaxing G4 to a mixed list.

ai-sync ClaudeMcpJson / CodexMcpServer / McpJsonServer model transport only (command, args, env, url, headers, timeout_ms, type). No protocol-version field exists. Root .mcp.json nlp entry likewise has no protocol field.
plugins/github/.mcp.json and plugins/notion/.mcp.json are third-party HTTP servers with no protocol field. plugins/box has no .mcp.json. .ai/mcp/mcp.json is an empty file.

mcp-kit README still names MCP protocol 2025-06-18. SanitizedSpan comments assume mcp-session-id is minted at initialize. Kit test fixture hard-codes protocolVersion 2025-06-18 and initializePayload. Hosts duplicate that stub.
nlp-mcp, uspto-mcp, and gov-legal-mcp have no JSON-RPC wire tests; they exercise callTool in-process. A G4 flip can keep those unit tests green while stdio launchers break.

v2026_07_28 reverse-client listRoots, createMessage, and elicit all fail unsupported. No in-repo host currently uses reverse-client, so this is not a current breakage, but it is a capability drop if a host later needs elicitation/sampling/roots.
Six hosts copy-paste protocols: [McpProtocol.v2025_06_18]. Centralizing that literal in mcp-kit is the actual G4 switch; CORS 2026 routing headers and an HTTP header injector belong next to it.
